column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/widgets/terminal.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in terminal.rs; the others
# move to src/widgets/terminal/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target terminal --check` after adding an item to terminal.rs.
# A struct whose private fields other files read (and the tests do) stays in terminal.rs,
# where every file under terminal/ and the tests can still read them; its methods move.
